column2: Koji-kun, what brings you here?
It's an emergency, Professor! The thing is...!
I understand the situation. First, {p}-kun! It's I who should be helping you! I'll arrange for the medical team to examine {s}-kun right away!
Thank you so much, Professor Yumi!
And Koji-kun!\n\nWe must not hand Mazinger Z over to Dr. Hell! THAT should be finished any moment now... Back to the lab!
Roger! All riiight, you just wait, Baron Ashura!
A meeting is in session. This corridor is closed. Please enter by the front door.
Science City's medical facility is first-rate.\n\nI'm sure {s}-kun will be well again soon.
Professor, thank you so much!
The truth is, the real agenda of this conference was the dimensional linking phenomenon.
Then you scientists know about worlds other than this one...?
Of course we do. In theory, at least. It seems a phenomenon where various worlds in different dimensions link together has been happening frequently of late.
I knew it...!
At this rate, something grave could happen! So I want to put your experiences to use in finding the cause!
I'd be glad to help!
Thank you! But first, we retake the Photon Power Lab!
All riiight, let's do this!
Once you're ready, we'll head out for the Photon Power Lab. Just say the word when you're set.
All set?
Then let's go!
I'm worried about Sayaka and Boss-kun too... Do your best, Koji-kun!
First, we retake the Photon Power Lab!
All riiight, the Photon Power Lab's just ahead!
Koji-kun! Look at that!
Wahahahahaha...!
Hohohohohoho...!
Mazinger Z is ours!
Mazinger Z belongs to Dr. Hell!
Mazinger!?\n\nWhat were Sayaka-san and the others doing!?
{!R}Koji-kun! I'm sorry!\n\n{!R}Baron Ashura launched an all-out attack!
{!R}Sorry, pal! We got our hands full with these Mechanical Beasts, see!
Hold on till I get Mazinger back!
Heh heh! I've got the perfect gift for Dr. Hell!
Looks like they're ready to receive it!
Take Mazinger Z
into the undersea fortress Saluud!
Ngh! The Pilder!? So you've come, Koji! My rival!
The Pilder must not dock with Mazinger!
Baron Ashura! My Mazinger Z! I won't hand it over to the likes of you!\n\nPilder! ON!!
Curses! Just one step away...!
Pull back the Saluud! Dive!
Mazinger's sinking into the sea!\n\nCan I really fight Mechanical Beasts on the seabed...?
But if we carelessly surface, we'll get hit by concentrated fire!
Let's move along the seabed and get closer to the Photon Power Lab!
Mazinger seems to have sunk into the sea!?
Next, it's the Photon Power Lab's turn!
...Koji-kun.
Sayaka! Don't you worry! You got me, so it's all good!
We'll just have to manage with Aphrodite A and Boss Borot! Hang in there, Boss!
Okey-dokey! You too, Sayaka!
So you've shown up, you walking heaps of scrap!
I'll show you the terror of Mechanical Beast Baron Ashura!
Look, it's like a deck for Mechanical Beasts. I'll get inside the Saluud from there and move through it!
All riiight! We made it outside!
We're far from the Photon Power Lab! The undersea fortress started moving at some point!
{!R}Can you hear me, Koji-kun!?\n\n{!R}THAT is finished! It's on its way to you now!
So the thing they were building in Science City made it in time!
What's "that"?
Just watch and you'll see. Here it comes!
Scrander! CROSS!
Amazing, Koji-kun!
Sayaka-san! Boss! I'm coming!
Mazinger Z!?
Curse you, Koji Kabuto!
Baron Ashura, let's settle this!
Gooo, Mazinger!
Koji-kun! And {p}-kun! Well done!
Um... how is {s}...?
Science City's medical team is doing everything they can to treat her. She should recover soon!
Thank goodness...
Koji-kun!
Heeey!
Sayaka-san! Boss!
Professor, friends are a wonderful thing...
You have wonderful friends too, don't you, {p}-kun!
Everyone!
...Now then. At present, we know nothing in detail about this phenomenon called the Dimension Chain. So we've decided to ask the Precog Clan for their help.
The Precog Clan?
Psychics, also called a band of prophets.
Where is the Precog Clan?
All we know is that they come from Herai Village.
Where's Herai Village? Sayaka, you know?
In the mountains to the northeast, I think.
Wherever it is, no problem!\n\nWith the Jet Scrander, it's just a hop away!
I'm afraid it isn't that simple, Koji-kun. Your robots need repairs.
Whaaat!
They really took a beating...
My Boss Borot... You poor thing...
Then, Professor, I'll go to Herai Village with my friends!
I'll help out too!
Me too!
All riiight, we're helpin' too!
You got it, Boss!
Hoyaaa! Boss!
Herai Village is a small village northeast of here, north of Science City. With the help of the Precog Clan who live there, we should be able to learn about the Dimension Chain.
Dr. Kuruma is utterly heartless, I tell you. They say he even sacrificed his wife and son to his research.
Dr. Kuruma insists that linking and mixing are evolution itself. Rumor has it he's experimenting with fusing animals together, I tell you.
Besides the Precog Clan, other gifted psychics exist... It's an open secret among scientists!
Huh? Hell Villa's here...!
GWAHAHAHAHA!
